label: PDCAN
description: Selected Physiology-Driven Control Aware Network using future-control-aware recurrent decoding without explicit predicted-output physiological feedback.

label: PDCAN-AR
description: Adds explicit feedback of the previous predicted HR/Tskin/Tcore into the next decoder step. This tests whether the old autoregressive-feedback mechanism improves or worsens the selected PDCAN.

label: PDCAN w/o future-control context
description: Removes the encoder-level global future-control context while retaining minute-level future controls in the decoder.

label: PDCAN w/o smoothness loss
description: Keeps the selected PDCAN architecture but removes the second-order trajectory smoothness regularization term.

label: PDCAN w/o residual mPSI calibration
description: Keeps the selected PDCAN trajectory decoder but removes the learned residual mPSI calibration head, leaving only the formula-based mPSI output.
